name: Entity IO Webhooks
description: Configure and send webhooks for entity events per entity and bundle.
project_description: Submodule of Entity IO. On entity create/update/delete (and content-moderation transitions) it exports the entity to JSON and, per entity type and bundle, delivers it to configured destinations: an HTTP POST to external webhook URLs (Guzzle), an email attachment via the SMTP module, or an FTP upload. Events, URLs, headers, mail and FTP settings are configured globally and overridden per bundle.
